ageCalculator.title: Dog Age Calculator
ageCalculator.tagline: Discover your canine companion's physiological age in human years.

sizes.label: Small
sizes.description: e.g., Pomeranian, Pug, Shih Tzu, Chihuahua

sizes.label: Medium
sizes.description: e.g., Beagle, Cocker Spaniel, Indian Pariah / Desi Dog

sizes.label: Large
sizes.description: e.g., Labrador Retriever, German Shepherd, Golden Retriever

sizes.label: Giant
sizes.description: e.g., Great Dane, Saint Bernard, Mastiff, Rottweiler

lifeStages.label: Puppy / Junior
lifeStages.careHint: Critical period for core vaccinations, deworming schedules, and developmental nutrition.

lifeStages.label: Young Adult
lifeStages.careHint: Peak physical vigor. Maintain annual wellness exams, dental hygiene, and active exercise.

lifeStages.label: Mature Adult
lifeStages.careHint: Middle-age transition. Focus on metabolic blood panels, weight control, and early joint care.

lifeStages.label: Senior Companion
lifeStages.careHint: Cherished golden years. Recommend bi-annual geriatric health checks, gentle mobility, and cardiac screens.

ageCalculator.disclaimer: This tool provides an approximate physiological estimate based on veterinary canine life-stage charts. Individual breed genetics, metabolic rate, and lifestyle influence biological aging.
